customer_question: Our product communicates with a smartphone via Bluetooth to open and close an automatic door, but it doesn't really have its own 'operations' -- what should we provide for the 'operation manual (Bluetooth section)' requirement?
question_variants: Should we submit a diagram of how the smartphone and device communicate?
Can we use the smartphone app's instruction manual instead of a device-specific manual?
What counts as an operation manual for a device with no UI of its own?
actual_issue: The registered device (an automatic door controller, SDC) communicated with a smartphone over Bluetooth but had no operations of its own to describe, since it was controlled entirely through a companion smartphone app, and it needed to be clarified what would satisfy the compliance folder's 'operation manual (Bluetooth section)' requirement in this situation.
plain_english_explanation: Some Bluetooth devices don't have any buttons, screens, or steps of their own to operate -- everything is done through a phone app that talks to the device in the background. For these kinds of devices, asking for a separate 'how to operate this device' manual doesn't really make sense, since there's nothing to operate directly. Instead, the phone app's own instructions, which describe how it works together with the device, can stand in for that requirement.
consultant_answer: It is common for BLE peripheral devices that pair with a smartphone to have no operations of their own. In such cases, as the customer correctly guessed, the operation manual for the companion smartphone app -- which describes the registered device as its counterpart peripheral -- is acceptable as the 'operation manual (Bluetooth section)' requirement.
decision_logic: When a registered BLE peripheral device has no operations of its own because it is controlled entirely through a companion smartphone app, the compliance folder's operation manual requirement is satisfied by the app's own instruction manual (provided it describes the registered device as its counterpart peripheral), rather than requiring a separate, device-specific operation document.
final_recommendation: For a headless BLE peripheral device controlled entirely via a companion app, accept the app's own instruction manual as satisfying the 'operation manual (Bluetooth section)' compliance folder requirement.
risk_if_done_wrong: Insisting on a dedicated operation manual for a device that has no operations of its own would create an impossible documentation requirement and unnecessarily delay compliance folder completion.
